skill_name: Write a news article on the topic of the current trend of automation.
workflow: Automation is quickly becoming a trend in the modern workforce, with many companies turning to automated services and processes to reduce costs and improve efficiency. Automation is being used in areas such as customer service, inventory management, data entry, and other tasks that previously required human input.
